title: BRICS Declaration: India’s Great U-turn on Iran
gist: At the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India calibrated the final declaration to avoid naming the United States while explicitly calling for an end to unilateral sanctions, protectionist trade measures and arbitrary tariffs; the author argues this outcome, hailed as strategic autonomy, actually diluted India's Modi-era foreign policy, notably a U-turn on Iran.

insights.claim: The BRICS summit declaration in New Delhi did not name the United States but explicitly called for an end to unilateral economic sanctions, protectionist trade measures and arbitrary tariffs.
insights.speaker: Asif Ullah Khan
insights.so_what: BRICS is formally positioning against US sanctions and tariff tools; watch for follow-through on alternative trade and payment arrangements.

insights.claim: India's foreign ministry used nuanced vocabulary to calibrate the BRICS declaration amid India's tug-of-war with the Trump administration, trying to balance China, Russia and Iran at the table.
insights.speaker: Asif Ullah Khan
insights.so_what: India's hedging between Washington and BRICS partners is a key variable for US-India trade negotiations and tariff risk.

insights.claim: The BRICS summit outcome hailed as a triumph of strategic autonomy actually diluted the foreign policy India has pursued since Narendra Modi came to power.
insights.speaker: Asif Ullah Khan
insights.so_what: Suggests India is tilting toward Iran/BRICS positions under US pressure, raising risk of friction with Washington.
insights.quote: what is being hailed as a triumph of strategic autonomy saw the dilution of India’s foreign policy since the advent of Prime Minister Narendra Modi
insights.locator: The surprising outcome of the summit

insights.claim: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian was hosted in New Delhi on the eve of the 18th BRICS Summit, underscoring warmer India-Iran engagement.
insights.speaker: Asif Ullah Khan
insights.so_what: Warmer India-Iran ties could complicate US sanctions compliance for Indian firms trading with Iran.
insights.locator: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian being honored
